Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the initial analysis by incorrectly identifying the director of the film "Safe (2012 Film)" as Boaz Yakin. Boaz Yakin directed the 2000 film "Remember the Titans," while the 2012 film "Safe" was directed by David Mackenzie. This fundamental error led the entire subsequent investigation to be based on the wrong director's birth year, resulting in an incorrect conclusion that Boaz Yakin (born 1965) was born earlier than Pupi Avati (born 1938), when in fact the comparison should have been against David Mackenzie (born 1966). While the birth years of Avati and Yakin were correctly retrieved, the initial premise regarding the director of the 2012 film was false.
